liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (1 review, 1 other source): Casey Jones runs through a jam into One More Saturday Night, about 45 minutes in total; Partial recording containing only half of the last song, plus the encore [1][4]
- **One More Saturday Night** (2 reviews): A tiger jam comes right before it; the reviewer expected Dark Star but the band chose this instead; Reviewer assumes it is from the 12-04 encore, absent from the official Winterland 1973 bonus disc [4][9]
- Reviewer's highlight was a China>Rider, though it is not among this partial recording's listed songs [8]

## The recordings

- **gd73-12-10pt.sbd.elliot.11800.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 2 songs; 7 min; rated 2/5 by 9 [1]

## Around the show

- A Spanish tease is audible roughly twelve minutes after Casey Jones ends [4]
- Only a few songs circulate; the complete show reportedly exists as a master reel soundboard in the vault [3]
- Reviewer says the 12/10/73 show is downloadable from dead.net, with only One More Saturday Night being an outtake [6]
- Reviewer says it is not the year's or fall tour's best, lacking big jams like Dark Star, more a first-set style party show [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-12-10pt.sbd.elliot.11800.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer claims these tracks are actually from 12-04-1973, with Casey Jones definitely from that show, not 12-10; Reviewer says this is the 4 Dec 73 show at the wrong speed, and the gd73-12-04 etree item is actually 10 Dec 73; Master soundboard cassette to reel to PCM to DAT to CDR; seeded to etree by Jools [1][9][10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1973-12-10 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1973-12-10-10/) [12]
- Poster by Qobuz: [Download Series Vol. 8: Charlotte Coliseum, Charlotte, NC 12/10/73 (Live), Grateful Dead - Qobuz](https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/download-series-vol-8-charlotte-coliseum-charlotte-nc-12-10-73-grateful-dead/0603497968992) [13]
